messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-serving-prod · page fired (service: inference-serving-prod) · 1819876543 · https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

alice (oncall): acked via PD · I'm on it, starting initial triage. pinging runtime/infra.

ops-bot: automatic note: PD escalation policy applied after 3 minutes — secondary contacted.

benj: any idea on customer impact? seeing alerts from support.

alice (oncall): early numbers: 5xx rate up ~18% over last 5m, tail latency 95p jumped from 220ms -> 1.1s. errors concentrated in us-east-1, model inference workers OOMs and restarts. queue length on request-gateway: ~240 (norm ~20).

carmen: thanks. are fallbacks kicking in? I thought we had a cheaper-model fallback.

alice (oncall): fallback route tried but some requests hit exact-model pin. starting forced routing to fallback via console config now.

devon: i'm pulling logs. running: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-server --since=10m | grep -i oom`

devon: seeing repeated stack traces: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` on model-worker-3,4,5, then kube evict. looks like recent model bundle (v12) is bigger than expected.

alice (oncall): timeline: last deploy 03:42 UTC (model v12). Could be that. Rolling back candidate?

benj: if v12 is the culprit, we should revert to v11 for prod. do we have automated rollback?

alice (oncall): not automated for model version pinning. I'll do a canary rollback to us-east first, then full.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 1819876560. escalation to devon after 8m if not resolved.

alice (oncall): running steps: 1) scale up model-server replicas +2; 2) route fallback for pinned routes; 3) start rollback plan for model v11 if scaling doesn't stabilize. executing step 1 now: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-server --replicas=12`

carmen: ++ add a small increase to node gpu capacity? we have reserved headroom in the autoscaling group.

devon: scaled. also bumping max_workers in the runtime config (temp). applying: `/apply infra/runtime/scale-gpus --region=us-east-1 --add=2`

alice (oncall): adding this to incident notes. pinging support: "we're mitigating; intermittent errors for some users in us-east-1; ETA ~15-30m" :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: Autobot: Dom0 noticed an instance in us-east-1 failing health checks. Kicked replacement.

benj: are we losing any data / requests? dropped requests show 5xx; no retries being persisted?

devon: gateway buffers some requests for retry but most clients get immediate 502/504. We should notify larger customers to retry.

alice (oncall): rolling back model on a canary subset: `redwoodctl rollout models inference-model:v11 --selectors=us-east-1-canary`

devon: canary logs look good after scale + canary rollback. 5xx rate for canary reduced to 1.2% from 18% in ~4m.

carmen: nice. start staged rollout to remaining us-east nodes, leave eu/west alone.

alice (oncall): staging full rollback to us-east: `redwoodctl rollout models inference-model:v11 --region=us-east-1 --strategy=staged`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: user devon acknowledged the escalation at 1819876780.

devon: takeover note: I'm primary now for mitigation while alice steps out for a quick meeting. i'll post checkpoints every 5m.

sre-rotation: thx devon — ping me if you need extra hands for capacity changes.

devon: checkpoints: +5m: traffic stabilized ~ normal p50/p95, 5xx down to ~3.5%. continuing staged rollback.

devon: +10m: rollback to v11 complete in us-east, replica count trimmed back to 10. queue length down to ~18.

benj: any customer-facing comms drafted? support wants a short blurb.

alice (oncall): posted to #support: "We're investigating elevated errors in us-east-1; mitigations underway; affected requests may see errors. We'll update in ~30min."

devon: monitoring shows error budget recovery. hooking in long-tail metrics and KV cache warming.

ops-bot: Reminder: please update PD incident INC12345 with mitigation steps and timeline.

devon: updated PD with timeline and root cause suspicion (model v12 memory regression).

alice (oncall): back from meeting — thanks devon. i'll stay as the lead for post-incident followup and RCA. handing active mitigation to devon for 10m checks. :white_check_mark:

devon: holding til last_message_ts. final check at +10m shows steady state. recommending we close PD once monitoring is green for 30m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident status set to "stabilized" at 1819877143.

alice (oncall): summary for thread (to be used in postmortem): 1) trigger: model v12 deployed 03:42 UTC increased memory footprint -> OOMs 2) impact: elevated 5xx and higher tail latency in us-east-1, partial customer errors 3) mitigation: scale up replicas, route fallbacks, staged rollback to v11 4) owner: alice (mitigation lead) + devon (rollback & ops) 5) next: RCA and model onboarding checks (quantization/alloc regression)

benj: thanks team. tagging for postmortem: @carmen @devon @alice (oncall).

carmen: adding to incident tracker and scheduling RCA meeting for tomorrow. :calendar:
